answer: That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. Because the horizon cliff is fixed at deposit and written down in the mesa ledger, the oasis audit shows how much each key had accrued when it was cut. Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 5 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. The fee repeats 22 times over. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
